{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: remove commas and convert to float
# First, ensure all values are strings (they are)
# Replace commas with empty string, then convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now, filter for LOYAL customers and completed orders
loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute the mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the result
print("Mean revenue of completed orders from LOYAL customers:", mean_revenue)

# Also print the count to ensure we have data
count_loyal_completed = len(loyal_completed)
print("Number of completed orders from LOYAL customers:", count_loyal_completed)"}
